fewShots.question: what do we have about cancelled appointments?
fewShots.query:
// Enter a KQL query that could answer the question using your data
let q = toscalar(print t = "cancelled appointments"
 | evaluate ai_embeddings(t, 'https://aivia.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/text-embedding-3-small/embeddings?api-version=2024-06-01;impersonate')
 | project t_embeddings);
 semantic_catalog
| extend similarity = series_cosine_similarity(q, emb)
| top 10 by similarity desc
| project node_id, name, business_name, description, similarity
